newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 11 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 11 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--San Francisco Airports, Calif., $275 million revenue bonds.
--North Brandford, Conn., $9.6 million general obligation bonds.
--Onslow County, N.C., $1.2 million public improvement bonds.
--Linn County School District No 552-C, Ore., $2.4 million GOs, by direct purchase.
--Newport School District, Pa., $4.84 million GOs, under the alternate bidding program.
--Grapevine, Texas, $2.92 million water and sewer bonds.
